# go — A SMALL INVENTED RESIDUE of assertions whose Strength changes when
# string literals are stripped, written for this repository.
#
# Every line is made up for the public copy of ThruLine (invented identifiers,
# invented paths, no third-party source). Each one carries a matcher word or
# operator INSIDE a string literal, so reading the literal exposes a different
# Strength than the stripped text does. `tests/corpus_ambiguity.rs` asserts every
# record here is STILL ambiguous.
#
# Format: <path>:<line><TAB><stripped>-><exposed><TAB><assertion text, escaped>.
